notes.title: Changelog #1: Abilities Patch
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce our first playtest patch and changelog for TagTime. We hope you are as excited as we are about the new ability mechanic defining the champions’ traits. 
We look forward to hearing from you! Join us on Discord; we welcome both lurkers, chatters, and talkers.

Changelog:
New features:

Abilities: Each champion now has a character-defining ability. The Monsters can make a blood trail appear, leading to the nearest Runt. The Runts can deploy decoys - clones of themselves - which can lead the Monsters astray.
Power-up: The Monsters can now get the Mini Monster power-up, which makes them small enough to fit in and run past the Runts' fortifications.


Changes:

Power-up: Removed the blood trail power-up as that is now an ability.


Bug fixes:

Matchmaking not correctly handling connection attempts.
Matchmaking not correctly matching games.


Next week, we will post our next Dev Log focusing on the design of our upcoming champions.
